title: Recent Commit Embodiment Atlas — #257 through #276
purpose: Re-read the twenty-commit carving sequence as one developing organism. For every commit, state what it visibly added, the deeper job it now performs, the concrete realities it can hold, what new knowledge it can produce when coupled to later commits, and what remains underfed.
depth_rule: A commit is not embodied merely because its files exist. It is embodied when its concepts have: purpose, inhabitants, mechanisms, evidence boundaries, interfaces, downstream questions and at least one discovery route.

commits.visible: Three symbolic navigation planes tied to D1-D11 and the Living Axis.
commits.latent_job: Separate orientation/regime questions without turning symbolic depth into rank or geography.
commits.new_value: The same entity can be inspected by aspiration/meaning, observable operation, and roots/unresolved substrate without duplicating the entity.
commits.underfed: Needs domain-specific examples showing one institution/event across all three planes.

commits.visible: Cardinal navigator, Tree of Life/Strife, comparative trees, Akashic archive metaphor.
commits.latent_job: Join orientation with branching consequence: where am I looking, what grows from the relation, and what memory supports it?
commits.new_value: A compass tells where a question points; Tree tells what the answer reproduces. Their combination distinguishes orientation from generativity.
commits.underfed: Needs relation-level cases where the same root produces Life or Strife under different regimes.

commits.visible: Rooms/holdings projected into planes and compass slices.
commits.latent_job: Demonstrate that navigation must be generated from canonical owners rather than hand-authored symbolism.
commits.new_value: Becomes the first bridge from ontology to queryable views.
commits.underfed: Population was repository-centric; needs real-world records and questions, now supplied by #276.

commits.visible: Canonical Tree/plane routing and exact Axis center.
commits.latent_job: Keep organism, terrain and orientation distinct while showing how one living network crosses contexts.
commits.new_value: Allows root/world/canopy to be interpreted as functions instead of moral strata.
commits.underfed: Needs examples of roots above/below, grafting, pruning, network inheritance and cross-plane feedback.

commits.visible: Seed junction, death, bidirectional spiral routes.
commits.latent_job: Model latency, irreversible change, recurrence with memory and generational transfer.
commits.new_value: Makes return measurable: what persists, what changes, what can seed the next cycle?
commits.underfed: Needs explicit distinction among dormancy, loss, transformation, inheritance and restart.

commits.visible: One navigation authority and curated religious-symbolic population.
commits.latent_job: Separate ownership from discovery: traditions keep their own meaning while becoming traversable by project questions.
commits.new_value: Enables source-first comparison rather than symbol collage.
commits.underfed: Needs richer questions and provenance pathways per tradition.

commits.visible: Great Seal Eye/pyramid/pillars, threshold architecture and historical guardrails.
commits.latent_job: Train the project to distinguish shared form from historical lineage.
commits.new_value: Provides a reusable historical-layer test for every esoteric comparison.
commits.underfed: Now strengthened by #272; needs reception-history timelines and documented variant diagrams.

commits.visible: Typed Mountain, Shadow, Swamp, Axis and contextual boundaries.
commits.latent_job: Stop spatial metaphors from becoming moral categories.
commits.new_value: Lets one place/entity occupy different regimes over time without essentializing it.
commits.underfed: Needs state-transition evidence and examples of regime change in concrete systems.

commits.visible: Operational placement plus underworld, mountain, labyrinth, messenger nodes.
commits.latent_job: Turn comparative mythology into a library of recurrent human problem-solutions: orientation, passage, danger, mediation, death, return.
commits.new_value: A tradition can answer a structural question without being assimilated to Potatoverse.
commits.underfed: Needs problem/function indexing beyond motif labels.

commits.visible: Garden, judgment, water, bardo, Olympus; navigable symbolic corridors.
commits.latent_job: Broaden beyond vertical ascent to ecology, judgment, transition, purification and differentiated afterlife/state systems.
commits.new_value: Shows that traditions solve similar existential problems with different architectures.
commits.underfed: Needs comparison by existential question: death, guilt, belonging, transformation, justice, knowledge.

commits.visible: Semantic center, center-out rings, comparative demotion.
commits.latent_job: Give synthesis a stable home without claiming every source originates there.
commits.new_value: Center becomes a query/orientation service rather than a universal provenance claim.
commits.underfed: Needs explicit purpose function: why should a reader return to center after exploring the world?

commits.visible: Wheel, polarity, memory, culture, practice plus Buddhism/Daoism/Akashic research.
commits.latent_job: Allow the same object to be reread through orthogonal dimensions without moving ownership.
commits.new_value: Prefigures the modern Spirit/Mind/Body and projection-switch model.
commits.underfed: Needs a general lens contract and examples where lenses disagree productively.

commits.theme: Living project — Body, Spirit, History, Culture
commits.visible: Four living metabolisms and center-native readers.
commits.latent_job: Move from static archive to organism: embodiment, meaning, memory and social reproduction.
commits.new_value: Provides metabolism categories for how knowledge becomes lived and transmitted.
commits.underfed: Mind/coordination was implicit; #276 now reveals a Spirit–Mind–Body triad needing integration with History/Culture.

commits.visible: Door, Spirit, Culture, Fruit, Tree deepened; all Rooms paired to center.
commits.latent_job: Make every Room state its contribution, boundary, handoff and test.
commits.new_value: Changes center from identity slogan to distributed interface contract.
commits.underfed: Pairings need real cases and failure data, not only descriptions.

commits.theme: Shadow / Garden / Repair / Revision / Fruit / local centers
commits.visible: Operational lifecycle and repair/revision contracts.
commits.latent_job: Give the system ethics and self-correction: observe what was excluded, cultivate capability, repair harm, revise canon, evaluate consequences.
commits.new_value: This is the project's strongest bridge from mythic grammar to practical institutional analysis.
commits.underfed: Needs longitudinal case records, measurable outcomes, consent/power analysis and purpose/capability criteria.

commits.visible: Deep element atlas and historically separated esoteric structures.
commits.latent_job: Teach disciplined comparison: internal grammar first, crosswalk second.
commits.new_value: Creates a reusable anti-flattening method for dense symbolic systems.
commits.underfed: Needs reception histories, primary-source excerpts/metadata and explicit comparison questions rather than ever-larger correspondence lists.

commits.theme: Alchemy / chakra / sacred geometry / biblical functions
commits.visible: Conversation archaeology plus multiple tradition/science atlases.
commits.latent_job: Recover project genealogy while protecting ancient/modern, symbolic/biological and mathematical/historical boundaries.
commits.new_value: Shows how one symbol can have independently typed mathematical, historical, bodily and project lives.
commits.underfed: Needs richer chain-of-transmission timelines and empirical checks where the project makes natural-pattern claims.

commits.visible: Flow, carrier, measure, coordinate and organism families.
commits.latent_job: Introduce ontology-by-type so superposition does not erase what kind of thing something is.
commits.new_value: Makes type mismatch itself a discovery tool: many false connections disappear when type is declared.
commits.underfed: Needs cross-domain cases and computational relationship examples.

commits.visible: Confusion registry; architecture/material/fire/animals/time; maturity matrix.
commits.latent_job: Treat ambiguity and incompleteness as first-class research objects.
commits.new_value: The project can now know what it does not yet know and avoid prematurely building weak ontology.
commits.underfed: Needs automatic diagnostics, contradiction logging and evidence-driven maturity criteria.

commits.visible: Concrete population families and institutional anchors.
commits.latent_job: Reverse the relation between ontology and world: grammar serves reality, not vice versa.
commits.new_value: Allows every earlier operator to become an analytic lens over observable systems.
commits.underfed: Reference population is still broad; next depth must use relationship graphs, longitudinal histories and rare-value discovery rather than catalog growth.

whole_sequence.phase_2: #262–266: establish source-first comparative population and placement.
whole_sequence.phase_3: #267–271: establish center, metabolism, operator mechanics, repair and self-correction.
whole_sequence.phase_4: #272–275: establish deep typed symbol knowledge and confusion management.
whole_sequence.phase_5: #276+: inhabit the system with society, purpose and discovery.
whole_sequence.emergent_thesis: The project has evolved from symbolic cosmography into a typed relational inquiry system. Its next value does not come from adding more symbols; it comes from using the accumulated grammar to discover consequential relations in life, institutions, history, culture and knowledge.

embodiment_tests: Can a concept name concrete inhabitants or records?
Can it state the real question it helps answer?
Can it identify its source/evidence class?
Can it state what would make the interpretation fail?
Can it hand off to another Room/operator without duplicating ownership?
Can it generate a new research path or decision rather than only a description?
Can a reader reach something rarer than ordinary reference information?
